overloadMerges.note: Added sentinel semantics for duration=0 (cancels an existing delay) documented in prose, and clarified it replaces rather than accumulates with any remaining delay.

params.name: duration
params.description: Delay expressed in ticks (1 tick = 1/60th second); replaces (does not add to) any remaining delay if the process is already delayed.

sentinelValues.meaning: cancel any remaining delay on the process

constraints: If the process does not exist, the command does nothing.
Cannot be used to delay a stored procedure on the server machine from a client machine (process < 0).
